negative_findings.description: Fakulteti.mk was named in the cell definition as a business/news portal, but MK/AL searches targeting its business desk returned no fakulteti.mk results at all — only unrelated education and Telegrafi pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: No fakulteti.mk URL surfaced in search; the site's business/economy coverage of bank-vendor deals could not be evidenced in this pass. Not recorded as dead — likely a search-index/ranking issue rather than an offline site.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: One of the named cell targets is unvalidated; if it does carry bank-tech coverage it is currently a blind spot.

negative_findings.description: A targeted MK query naming likely core vendors (Асеко/Asseco, Halcom, Printec) alongside 'потпиша договор' and 'платежни терминали' returned no MK press article naming a bank-vendor contract.
negative_findings.result_summary: Results were bank T&C PDFs and generic product pages; no MK-language media item explicitly naming a technology supplier contract was retrieved.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Suggests MK media rarely name the technology supplier in deal stories — vendor attribution will usually have to come from vendor press releases, procurement records or bank annual reports, with MK press used only for the timing signal.

negative_findings.description: The available web search is US-indexed and returns only first-page-style result sets; deep paging into MK portal archives was not possible from search alone.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recall for MK/AL long-tail portals is likely incomplete; several candidates were found only indirectly via aggregator and snowball links.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Source discovery for this cell should be re-run against on-site search endpoints and TIME.mk's outlet directory rather than relying on general web search.

negative_findings.description: No fetch/liveness checking was performed on any listed URL in this pass; all URLs come from search result listings.
negative_findings.result_summary: All candidates are unverified for reachability, robots.txt policy and paywall/consent-wall behaviour.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Access_status and collection feasibility fields are hypotheses that the deterministic verification pass must confirm.

coverage_gaps.description: No MK-language marketing/PR trade outlet (e.g. Marketing365-type media) or specialised procurement-watch portal was confirmed, so vendor-side campaign and tender announcements in MK are uncovered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated pass on MK marketing/PR and public-procurement media, and cross-reference the state e-procurement bulletin for bank-adjacent state entities.

coverage_gaps.description: Historical archives (pre-2015 deal announcements, executive moves, outage reports) were not probed; TIME.mk's own note indicates its full archive search covers 2000-2012, a different window from live monitoring.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a retrospective harvest plan combining TIME.mk archive search, ekonomijaibiznis.mk legacy Newslist.aspx search, and per-portal site search for historical vendor mentions.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language coverage is represented (Portalb, Zhurnal, Aktuale, Telegrafi) but Turkish-language MK media, relevant given Halkbank's Turkish ownership, was not searched at all.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a Turkish-language sub-pass (Yeni Balkan and similar MK Turkish outlets) for Halkbank/Ziraat-related technology and partnership news.

coverage_gaps.description: System outage and incident reporting — an explicit rationale for this cell — was not evidenced by any retrieved article; only launches and policy items surfaced.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Design outage-specific MK queries (пад на системот, не работи е-банкарство, прекин, дефект, картички не работат) plus social/forum monitoring, since outages are reported by users before media.

brief: North Macedonia's MK-language business press is a small but workable layer: a specialised vertical (Bankarstvo.mk) plus business portals (Kapital, Faktor, Ekonomija i biznis, Pari, Bloomberg Adria's Skopje hub) and an ICT outlet (IT.mk) that is typically first with fintech licences and app launches. TIME.mk is the key pointer asset — it aggregates essentially the whole MK media field and its outlet directory is the fastest route to portals not yet in the registry. Albanian-language coverage (Portalb, Zhurnal, Aktuale, Telegrafi's MK economy stream) is a genuine second channel, carrying public-payments and diaspora-banking items that MK-only monitoring misses. The critical limitation observed is that MK media report the bank and the customer-facing feature but almost never name the technology supplier, so this cell should be treated as a high-value timing and actor-mapping signal that must be joined to vendor PR, procurement and annual-report sources for vendor attribution.
